question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Cost an arm and a leg
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Very expensive".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Cost an arm and a leg"** means something that is extremely expensive or costs a lot of money. (बहुत महंगा)

 
 
• **Example:** The new iPhone costs an arm and a leg, so I decided to wait for a sale.
 
 
 
• **"Very expensive"** describes something that requires a significant amount of money to purchase or acquire. (बहुत महंगा)
 
 
• **Example:** Luxury cars are very expensive, and only a few people can afford them.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "Cost an arm and a leg" means "Very expensive".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Affordable** (सस्ता): Something reasonably priced that most people can buy.

 
 
• **Example:** The local market offers affordable clothing for everyone.
 
 
 
• **Inexpensive** (अल्प मूल्य): Something that is not costly or very cheap.
 
 
• **Example:** This store sells high-quality products at inexpensive prices.
 
 
 
• **Free of charge** (बिना शुल्क): Something that does not require payment or is provided for free.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum entry is free of charge on Sundays.
 
 

32:T934,

The correct answer is **option 3.**&l
